title: Dhongbaaz
desc: Upon learning about his bride's unfaithfulness, an anguished groom delves into her past to uncover the truth, all while the wedding guests impatiently await his return.

title: Prioritize Family
desc: In this narrative, we follow the journey of a man who didn't treat his wife kindly. His work often invaded their home, and one day, he even invited his secretary over. Unhappy with this, his wife goes missing the next morning, making him realize her true value. Will she return? Tune in to discover the outcome.

title: Hearts Awash In Sapphire Light
desc: Hearts Awash in Sapphire Light unfolds the tale of two individuals who encounter each other one evening, initially under less-than-ideal circumstances. At first, they engage in petty arguments over trivial matters. However, as time passes, the undeniable power of their connection becomes evident, serving as a poignant reminder that sometimes, the most extraordinary journeys take place within the depths of our own hearts.

title: Hausla
desc: Danish, a village boy with kabaddi dreams, faces adversity as he's unfairly removed from his team due to a dispute he didn't start. Despite family discord, his father stands by him. A new opportunity arises, showcasing Danish's talent. He's selected for the biggest game of his life, but tragedy strikes: his father passes away. Will Danish find the strength to play on, honoring his father's memory?

title: Anu Aur Di
desc: Late at night, an angry girl had a fight with her boyfriend and called her sister. She had a big suitcase when her sister picked her up in the car. During the drive, they argued and brought up old problems. Things got worse, and the older sister pushed the younger one against the car window in anger. Their argument stopped suddenly when police lights flashed in the dark, and officers pulled them over. The air was tense with anticipation. What would come to light during this unexpected encounter with the police?

title: Prison
desc: Mini undergoes an assault, and shortly thereafter, her tormentors meet a grim fate. Stricken with fear and disbelief over these uncanny coincidences, Mini questions the source of these events. Could it be her confidante Bini, or something else entirely?

title: Adhure Poore Se Hum
desc: Two college time friends embark on a long drive on a Sunday morning, leaving their bustling city lives behind. As they amble through the hilly roads, they reveal to each other, their old longings and hidden pasts. Their rose tinted nostalgia is broken and they come face to face with their imperfect lives.

title: Annie
desc: Annie, who had recently experienced the loss of her unborn child, crosses paths with an enigmatic homeless man one evening. Unbeknownst to her, that meeting was on the brink of altering her life permanently.

title: Loha Chor
desc: A modest family from Haryana relocated to Dhanbad, Bihar, and took up residence in a government quarter that had previously been inhabited by the notorious "Loha Chor" gang during the 1980s in Bihar. The family encountered numerous challenges and social difficulties from both the local neighbourhood inhabitants and the remnants of the Loha Chor gang. Subsequently, law enforcement authorities conducted a raid on the premises. Through determination and courage, both the family and the protagonist of this story effectively navigated the situation in order to resolve the issue and find a resolution.

title: Budhwaar
desc: In this captivating story, a man residing in a village embarks on a journey to purchase a piece of land within his community, seeking assistance from the sarpanch. Despite his wife and the sarpanch's warnings against buying the land on Budhwaar (Wednesday) due to its inauspicious nature, the man disregards their concerns and proceeds with the purchase. Filled with joy, he begins digging the land with aspirations of cultivating vegetables. However, his enthusiasm is short-lived as he soon discovers the land's infertility. His dreams are shattered as the realization dawns upon him that he has fallen victim to a deceitful scheme. What he decides to do next is a must-see, making this story all the more intriguing.

title: Oh My Star Wife
desc: Story of a young married actress struggling with societal pressure over her fashion choices. Her husband's disapproval leads to arguments and a dilemma regarding societal acceptance. Ultimately, an unexpected accident brings resolution. Watch to explore how the protagonist navigates through societal expectations and challenges in her personal life.

title: Naam Badal Dena
desc: A couple who is head over heels in love with each other with a love that's extraordinary yet relatable. The wife is told by everyone that she is too trusting of her husband. The wife makes a pact with her husband that if she ever acts like an ordinary suspecting wife he can change her name. The universe then puts her to the test on their wedding anniversary. The husband then makes her admit her true feelings as a wife and believe that possessiveness and jealousy in moderation are good.

title: Chashmadeed
desc: A 60 YO woman lives with her entitled 30-year-old son and his wife. She is a doting mother to him, and like any mother, thinks of her son as ideal. One morning, she starts having a strange issue with her eyes, as her vision keeps getting blurred in erratic spasms, like a camera going out of focus and back. Upon the recommendation of her 23-year-old hip and woke neighbor, she sets out to visit an eye clinic by herself. The solution offered at this eye clinic more than clears her blurry vision.

title: Salwate
desc: The tale of a mother and son trapped in a challenging home situation and how a straightforward life tip helped them escape their predicament.

title: Live A Little
desc: It starts with an after-party sequence. It is late at night. Nimisha, 26, struggles to get a ride back home when Atish, 46, sees this and offers her help. She refuses at first but eventually agrees. The journey gives Nimisha a peek into her boss's life. As they reach Nimisha’s destination they are ready to move on in their lives, but the night has more to offer them. Due to a sudden turn of events, they end up under one roof and despite their differences, they help each other get a new perspective

title: Manita
desc: In a tale of wealth and solitude, two orphaned brothers lead opulent yet lonely lives, marked by the younger sibling's constant neglect by the elder.

title: Threes A Couple
desc: 3 Lives Change after they cross each other's path on one auspicious night.

title: Soul For Sole
desc: The real essence of life is found in serving others. A regular postman, with little else in his world but his job, faithfully delivers letters throughout his challenging life. One day, an unexpected encounter offers him a new purpose to live

title: Horror Chapters
desc: Many horror events, interaction with super natural possibilities. Exploring the Paranormal

title: Thanks Mom
desc: Thanks Mom is a human & a universal story of every mother & son that will melt your hearts away. The film's strength is its emotional value and connectivity to the viewers. It is the most honest & truest form of interpretation of a mother's role. It highlights a mom-son connection that is frayed and rough around the edges, filled with awkward silences and unsaid feelings that both find difficult to navigate but come around for each other when the time comes.

title: Abnormal
desc: This is the tale of a mother who grapples with societal challenges due to her transgender son. She confronts opposition from her family and the broader community, yet resolves to safeguard her child's future. Eventually, she triumphs in establishing their identity within society.

title: Chumbak
desc: "Chumbak" follows Aryan and Mitisha, once inseparable lovers, who reunite after years. The old flame reignites, but life has diverged their paths. Caught between duty and desire, they must navigate tough choices, testing their love against the changed tides of circumstance. A poignant tale of love's resilience in the face of reality.

title: Live A Little Part 2
desc: After 5 years, Nimisha and Atish meet again at a party. She is awarded Best Emerging Entrepreneur by none other than Atish. Atish couldn't let another day go by without confronting Nimisha. Both seem happy and has moved on in their lives until they realize they've been living in a delusion. They reminded each other of their Pact which was made 5 years ago. Live a Little . Then made sudden plans which led to unexpected confessions which led to the most memorable night of their lives.

title: Chashmishq
desc: A tale of two budding lovers, their glasses, and the unforeseen challenges that come between their first kiss.

title: Sizzle Of Shadows
desc: A doctor encounters a couple suffering from Dementia, and attempts to alleviate their condition. Upon receiving a call from the couple's son who lives in America, the doctor visits their home and is shocked to find the couple arguing and displaying symptoms of Dementia. The doctor diagnoses the woman with Lewy bodies Dementia, which causes visual hallucinations.
